test_title: PYST 2: SSC CHSL - Reasoning (Held On: 09 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure from the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5091c277e4973e15eb08c8df4c82bb585585bdfe42bc11b49eb14f6129a10aee.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Step I: The line with triangle is shifting in previous place and changed vertically in alternate place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3934f474b108a8df0ce54143f3667106ee76d687eda515d9f8091f82cb212b8f.png] 

Step II: The line with circle is shifting in previous place and changed vertically in alternate place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6021632b6e8cc08e32bc7318873564105d9576ab203313d150476fd7c46baf69.png] 

Step III: The line with square box is shifting in previous place and changed vertically in alternate place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1b40d53d13675ad1e38a047c40b0d0004c659b8a4d8a95aa6175162a9a1a4c01.png] 

Step IV: The line with triangle is shifting in previous place and changed vertically in alternate place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8f72ba858f9299421ddb5c837613be40362885582f73a458b5360d660e23928c.png] 

So, the complete series will be:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a1211e139cd0dbc248e5ae617e4c5a0054682008dfcd04941ea65ca9d4eb742a.png] 

So, 'Option 4' will replace the question mark.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
